6647.title: Cross-provider skill deduplication preserves a single provider owner
6647.rootCauseOneLine: The server sorts provider-qualified skill registrations and deduplicates by name/content without merging provider attribution, retaining acp-cursor.

prReviews.topFinding: Same-ID grouping does not cover the distinct IDs returned by real native discovery.

6647.proposedFix: Merge provider ownership at the actual name/content deduplication boundary and render multi-provider skills as Shared; retain single-provider ownership.
6647.caveats: Real discovery-to-HTTP regression reproduced twice; no live CLI or browser run. Full test and selected output are inline under the reports repository artifact policy. No duplicate fix PR because #6648 is open.
